name: Crimson Creek
description: The creek runs slow and rust-red between pale boulders — the colour, the locals tell no one, comes from the dye-pits further upstream, though no dyer has worked them in a generation. A stand of red lotuses pushes up through the stones in spite of the season; their petals are thick as lacquer. A narrow path bends east into a cleft that ought to lead nowhere.
first_visit_text: A bronze bell hangs from a branch at the path's edge. Its tongue has been stolen — or removed — and nothing remains but the mouth. When the wind tugs it, it still seems to toll, somewhere further in.

name: Scarlet Lotus Hidden Shrine
description: A pavilion of dark lacquered wood rises from an island in the middle of a still pond. The pond itself is red — whether with petals, silt, or something else is a question the pavilion does not answer. Bronze censers smoke along the gallery; the smoke smells of iron and sweetgrass. Disciples in robes the colour of cut wrists move between the pillars without speaking.
first_visit_text: You step onto the bridge. The water beneath you is not stirring at your passage; it is stirring in advance of it, as though something already under the surface is moving to meet you. No one here hurries. No one here needs to.
